import bpy, os, math, pathlib, subprocess, json
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
EXPECTED=os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(r'C:\mcp-blender\salvador_lacerda_do_zero.blend'))
if os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(bpy.data.filepath))!=EXPECTED: raise RuntimeError(f'ABORTADO arquivo errado {bpy.data.filepath!r}')
# arquivo está salvo antes deste lote; rollback integral em qualquer falha
def rollback(msg):
    print('ROLLBACK',msg)
    bpy.ops.wm.revert_mainfile()
    raise RuntimeError(msg)
try:
    parent=bpy.data.collections.get('01 WORLD | ELEVADOR LACERDA | blockout v4')
    low=bpy.data.collections.get('D | ESTACAO CIDADE BAIXA | blockout v1')
    terrain=bpy.data.objects.get('WORLD | TERRENO MASTER | blockout')
    if not parent or not low or not terrain or terrain.type!='MESH': rollback('estrutura base/terreno master ausente')
    tower=next((o for o in parent.objects if 'torre documental' in o.name.lower() and o.type=='MESH'),None)
    hall=next((o for o in parent.objects if 'hall piso terreo marcador' in o.name.lower() and o.type=='MESH'),None)
    if not tower or not hall: rollback('anchors torre/hall ausentes')
    tower_xy=Vector((tower.location.x,tower.location.y))
    # 1) ESTAÇÃO BAIXA: rotação -90° no plano em torno do centro cadastral da torre.
    ang=-math.pi/2
    c,s=math.cos(ang),math.sin(ang)
    def rotxy(v): return Vector((c*v.x-s*v.y,s*v.x+c*v.y))
    before={o.name:(o.location.copy(),o.rotation_euler.copy()) for o in low.objects}
    for o in low.objects:
        rel=Vector((o.location.x,o.location.y))-tower_xy; nr=rotxy(rel)
        o.location.x=tower_xy.x+nr.x; o.location.y=tower_xy.y+nr.y
        o.rotation_euler.z += ang
    low['orientation_fix']='rotated -90deg about cadastral tower center; facade transverse to tower-high axis'
    low['orientation_basis']='photo QA + official terrain + tower OSM alignment'
    # 2) TERRENO: substitui DATA do mesmo objeto, nunca cria segundo objeto de terreno.
    work=pathlib.Path(r'C:\mcp-blender\.geo-work'); npz=work/'terrain_2017_candidate.npz'
    if not npz.exists(): rollback('terrain_2017_candidate.npz ausente')
    py=r'C:\mcp-blender\.venv-geo\Scripts\python.exe'; out=work/'terrain_mesh_payload.json'; script=work/'make_terrain_payload.py'
    script.write_text(r'''
import numpy as np,json
d=np.load(r'C:\mcp-blender\.geo-work\terrain_2017_candidate.npz'); v=d['verts'].copy(); DATUM=3.20082950592041; v[:,:,2]-=DATUM; ny,nx,_=v.shape; verts=v.reshape(-1,3).tolist(); faces=[]
for y in range(ny-1):
 b=y*nx; nb=(y+1)*nx
 for x in range(nx-1):
  i=b+x; faces.append([i,i+1,nb+x+1,nb+x])
json.dump({'verts':verts,'faces':faces,'shape':[ny,nx],'datum_abs_m':DATUM,'zmin':float(v[:,:,2].min()),'zmax':float(v[:,:,2].max())},open(r'C:\mcp-blender\.geo-work\terrain_mesh_payload.json','w'),separators=(',',':'))
''',encoding='utf-8')
    r=subprocess.run([py,str(script)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=90)
    if r.returncode or not out.exists(): rollback('falha preparando malha oficial '+r.stderr[-500:])
    payload=json.loads(out.read_text())
    oldmesh=terrain.data; me=bpy.data.meshes.new('WORLD | TERRENO MASTER | PMS 2017')
    me.from_pydata(payload['verts'],[],payload['faces']); me.update()
    # conserva material existente
    for m in oldmesh.materials: me.materials.append(m)
    terrain.data=me
    if oldmesh.users==0: bpy.data.meshes.remove(oldmesh)
    terrain.location=(0,0,0); terrain.rotation_euler=(0,0,0); terrain.scale=(1,1,1)
    terrain['source']='Prefeitura Municipal de Salvador MAPA_BASE: layer 111 Curva de nivel 2017 + layer 109 Ponto cotado altimetrico'
    terrain['crs']='SIRGAS 2000 / UTM 24S EPSG:31984'
    terrain['grid_step_m']=2.0
    terrain['vertical_datum']='Blender Z = altitude oficial - 3.2008295059 m (mediana Praça Cairu oficial)'
    terrain['vertical_datum_offset_abs_m']=payload['datum_abs_m']
    terrain['validation_rmse_m']=0.22064422522364485
    terrain['validation_median_abs_m']=0.145599835382356
    terrain['validation_max_abs_m']=0.6502103297820341
    terrain['status']='TERRENO OFICIAL INTERPOLADO - PMS 2017; grade 2m; único terreno mestre'
    terrain['z_range_local_m']=(payload['zmin'],payload['zmax'])
    # 3) QA estrutural específico
    terrains=[o for o in bpy.data.objects if o.type=='MESH' and 'TERRENO MASTER' in o.name.upper() and not o.hide_viewport]
    if len(terrains)!=1 or terrains[0] is not terrain: rollback('QA terreno único falhou '+str([o.name for o in terrains]))
    if len(terrain.data.vertices)<50000: rollback('QA resolução terreno inesperada')
    # torre precisa continuar exatamente no anchor cadastral/OSM comprovado
    if (Vector((tower.location.x,tower.location.y))-tower_xy).length>1e-5: rollback('torre foi movida indevidamente')
    EX=(hall.location.xy-tower.location.xy).normalized(); EY=Vector((-EX.y,EX.x))
    pillars=sorted([o for o in low.objects if 'pilar fachada' in o.name.lower()],key=lambda o:o.name)
    if len(pillars)<2: rollback('pilares fachada baixa ausentes')
    d=(pillars[-1].location.xy-pillars[0].location.xy).normalized()
    if abs(d.dot(EY))<0.98: rollback(f'fachada baixa não ficou transversal dotEY={d.dot(EY):.4f}')
    # bounding local depois da correção
    pts=[]
    for o in low.objects:
        if o.type=='MESH': pts += [o.matrix_world@Vector(c) for c in o.bound_box]
    vals=[((p.xy-tower_xy).dot(EX),(p.xy-tower_xy).dot(EY),p.z) for p in pts]
    print('LOWER_AFTER_BOUNDS_EX_EY_Z',tuple(round(x,3) for x in (min(v[0] for v in vals),max(v[0] for v in vals),min(v[1] for v in vals),max(v[1] for v in vals),min(v[2] for v in vals),max(v[2] for v in vals))))
    print('LOWER_FACADE_DOT_EY',round(d.dot(EY),6))
    print('TERRAIN_VERTS',len(terrain.data.vertices),'FACES',len(terrain.data.polygons),'DIMS',tuple(round(float(x),3) for x in terrain.dimensions),'ZRANGE',payload['zmin'],payload['zmax'])
    # QA global existente, se disponível na cópia local do projeto
    qa_path=r'C:\mcp-blender\projeto-salvador-elevador-lacerda\scripts\qa_world_blockout.py'
    if os.path.exists(qa_path):
        code=open(qa_path,encoding='utf-8').read(); exec(compile(code,qa_path,'exec'),{'__name__':'__main__'})
    print('BATCH_0113_QA_PASS_NOT_SAVED')
except Exception as e:
    if 'BATCH_0113_QA_PASS' not in str(e):
        # Só reverte se ainda estivermos no arquivo esperado; evita cascata depois de rollback já feito.
        try:
            if os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(bpy.data.filepath))==EXPECTED: bpy.ops.wm.revert_mainfile()
        except: pass
    raise
